aboutPreview.title: A Home Away From Home
paragraphs: Gotabgaa Australia Chapter brings together Kalenjin families and friends across the continent — preserving our rich heritage while building a strong, united community in Australia.
From cultural celebrations to youth mentorship and economic empowerment, we create spaces where tradition meets opportunity.

hero.title: About Gotabgaa Australia
hero.description: Connecting Kalenjin families and friends across Australia through unity, heritage, and excellence.

about.lead: We are an independent Australian Kalenjin community association dedicated to connecting, uplifting, and empowering individuals and families across the continent.
about.mission: Inspire, connect, and economically empower our members through education, networking, investment opportunities, and cultural awareness in Australia.
about.vision: Unite members and provide a platform where talent, leadership, culture, and innovation are nurtured — bridging Kenya and Australia.
about.quote: From the savannas of Kenya to the shores of Australia — our roots unite us, our dreams propel us forward.

events.title: Annual Cultural Fete 2026
events.summary: Flagship heritage celebration with music, dance, and cuisine for all ages.
events.description: Our flagship celebration of Kalenjin heritage — traditional music, dance, storytelling, cuisine, and games for all generations. Food vendors, children's activities, and live performances throughout the day.
events.ticketPriceNote: Free registration — secure payment coming soon

events.title: Brisbane Chapter Meetup
events.summary: Connect with Brisbane members and welcome new families to the chapter.
events.description: Monthly chapter meetup for Brisbane members and families. Networking, welcome for new arrivals, and planning for upcoming programs. Light refreshments provided.
events.ticketPriceNote: Free registration — secure payment coming soon

events.title: Youth Mentorship Workshop
events.summary: Career guidance and mentorship for students and young professionals.
events.description: Career guidance and mentorship for young members navigating education and employment in Australia. Guest speakers from our professional network share insights on study pathways, CV writing, and workplace culture.
events.ticketPriceNote: Free registration — secure payment coming soon

events.title: Kokwet Sports Day
events.summary: Football, athletics, and family games across chapter teams.
events.description: Annual sports day featuring football, athletics, and family games. Teams from Sydney, Melbourne, and interstate chapters compete. Bring your family — picnic areas and refreshments on site.
events.ticketPriceNote: Free registration — secure payment coming soon

events.title: WA Community Gathering
events.summary: Western Australia chapter gathering with performances and shared lunch.
events.description: Western Australia chapter gathering with cultural performances, community updates, and a shared lunch. Opportunity to meet the WA leadership team and learn about local initiatives.
events.ticketPriceNote: Free registration — secure payment coming soon

events.title: Annual General Meeting 2026
events.summary: Annual reports, elections, and strategic planning for the chapter.
events.description: Chapter AGM covering annual reports, elections, and strategic priorities for 2026. Members voted on committee positions and approved the benevolence fund budget. Minutes available on request.

events.title: Heritage Day Celebration 2025
events.summary: Traditional dance, dress, and storytelling honouring our roots.
events.description: A vibrant day of traditional dance, dress, and storytelling honouring Kalenjin roots. Over 200 members attended from Victoria and interstate chapters.

events.title: Community BBQ & Gifting Ceremony
events.summary: BBQ and ceremony recognising members and contributors.
events.description: Community BBQ followed by a gifting ceremony recognising outstanding members and benevolence fund contributors. Families enjoyed games and shared meals together.
